load_model: load a pretrained causal LM model with optional 4bit or 8bit quantization and fast kernel support
load_peft_model: load a PEFT adapter model onto an existing base model for performance optimization
load_llama_from_config: load a Llama or Mllama model from a config path for FSDP checkpoint loading
review_load_model: review the load_model function to understand quantization config and attention implementation options
test_load_llama_from_config: test the load_llama_from_config function with a llama or mllama config path
